# StarRating

```ts
import { StarRating } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A read-only star score — how a supplier, product or review was rated. It shows a result; it doesn't take input. To ask people for a score, use Rating (a numbered scale); for thumbs up/down results use Thumbs Rating.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | **required** | The score, 0–max. Whole stars are drawn; the number is rounded for the stars. |
| `max` | `number` | `5` | How many stars make the scale. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'lg'` | `'sm'` | sm 28px stars (12px text), lg 32px stars (bold 20 value, medium 16 label). |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the score as text before the stars (Figma showValue), formatted with one decimal ("4.0") unless you pass valueText. |
| `valueText` | `string` | — | Custom score text (e.g. "4.3 (128)"); implies showValue. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Optional label after the stars ("Approved supplier"). |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<StarRating value={4} />
<StarRating value={3} showValue />
<StarRating value={4.3} valueText="4.3 (128)" />
<StarRating value={5} label="Approved supplier" />
<StarRating value={2} size="lg" showValue label="Relationship" />
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-rating-filled`, `--color-rating-outline`, `--color-rating-empty`, `--space-050`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--type-size-caption`, `--type-size-title`, `--type-size-subject`, `--space-100`

## Accessibility

- role="img" with a full-sentence name ("Rated 4 out of 5 stars"); the stars, value and label inside are hidden so nothing is announced twice. Pass aria-label to word it differently.
- Filled vs outline shape carries the score, so it doesn't rely on color alone.
- It isn't focusable — there's nothing to do with it.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use to show a score someone already gave | Use to collect a score — that's Rating |
| Add showValue when the exact number matters | Rely on half-filled stars (they aren't drawn) |
| Keep the scale at 5 | Change max between screens |
| Label what was rated when it isn't obvious | Leave a row of stars unexplained |
